root_cause: priority path re-verified six TPEx latest-session candidates (131444551 bytes = 1.83x VERIFIED_METADATA_CACHE_BYTES 71680000; 12.3 s uncached on hosted; TWSE six = 12936111 bytes = 0.18x) every pull, then evicted every older-session cached bundle including the history bundle being swept; TPEx history advanced exactly 16 rows per pull vs TWSE 192-304 (coordinator hosted numbers, cited not re-measured)

reproduction_hosted_shaped_fake.shape: 4 same-day runs + 2 runs fetched same day carrying previous session + 1 history bundle (8 rows); steady-state pull, small bodies, counts of transport reads
reproduction_hosted_shaped_fake.before_origin_dev: per pull: manifest.json 3, items.jsonl 3, index.json 2 (history bundle re-read after priority eviction)

design: _PRIORITY_DELIVERED_MEMO (in memory, <=64 scopes): after a pull finds the latest session fully delivered, remembers trade date, cursor key, held, hash of persisted delivered items and a fingerprint of every index entry with upper bound >= trade date; identical fingerprint+state returns None without any verification
_PRIORITY_TRADE_DATE_MEMO (in memory, <=512 entries): trade date proven per (scope, run_id, bundle_sha256); a candidate with a proven earlier session than the best is skipped
eviction now releases only earlier-session candidates verified this pull, so the history bundle stays cached across pulls
new run, changed bundle_sha256, process restart, pending items: fully verified as before (memo is dropped or mismatched)
persisted_state: no field added; latest_priority.json unchanged (old and new release read each other's file); one file per connector
memory: VERIFIED_METADATA_CACHE_BYTES/ENTRIES unchanged; memos hold short strings only; fewer bundles resident than before (history no longer evicted, no extra retention)
limits: acceptance 9 (hosted throughput) is measured by the coordinator after deploy; large-body 21.9 MB cache thrash on the first pull after a restart or a new run is verified as today by design
